key_provisions_or_claims: Poland may extend until 24 October 2027 its authorisation of Biobor JF for aircraft fuel tank treatment.
Justified by air transport safety and lack of alternative products.
Manufacturer has applied for active substance approval via ECHA in June 2025.
Addressed to the Polish competent authority.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision allowing Poland's medicines and biocides office to extend until 24 October 2027 its permission for the biocidal product Biobor JF to treat microbial contamination of aircraft fuel tanks, under Regulation (EU) No 528/2012. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1104 concerning the extension of the action taken by the Polish Office for Registration of Medicinal Products, Medical Devices and Biocidal Products permitting the making available on the market and use of the biocidal product Biobor JF
